title: Verify offline bundle signature during preflight (fail closed on invalid/untrusted)
author: Ethan Park
description: Context: As part of the Redwood Private on-prem/offline bundle signing initiative, the installer must verify bundle provenance before any install/upgrade steps run. This PR adds signature verification to the installer preflight and fails closed when the signature is invalid or the signing key is not trusted. This is the first enforcement point; trust-store/rotation and break-glass flows will land in follow-up PRs. What this does: - Adds a new preflight gate `verify-offline-bundle-signature` that runs after bundle discovery but before unpack/apply. - Verifies that `bundle/manifest.json` is present and canonicalizable, and that it contains a signature envelope (`signing` block) produced by the release pipeline. - Verifies the signature over the canonical manifest bytes using Ed25519 (Go stdlib `crypto/ed25519`). - Validates trust via a single pinned Redwood release public key shipped with the installer (temporary until trust store work in PR-24859). - Blocks install/upgrade on: missing signature, invalid signature, unsupported algorithm, or unknown key id. - Adds structured error codes so Support can triage consistently (see `docs/error-codes.md`). Canonicalization details (v0): - We canonicalize the manifest for verification by re-encoding JSON with stable key ordering and no insignificant whitespace. The implementation is intentionally strict and will error if unknown top-level keys are present in the `signing` block (to avoid signature bypass via ambiguous parsing). - The preflight prints the calculated manifest digest (sha256 of canonical bytes) for debugging. UX / CLI: - `redwood-private-installer preflight --bundle /path/to/bundle.tgz` now emits a clear PASS/FAIL result for signature verification. - On failure, we print: error code, reason, the expected key id (if present), and the log path. - No override flag is introduced in this PR (break-glass is a separate security decision; see ENG-4824). Testing: - Unit tests for: tampered manifest, mismatched signature, missing signing block, unknown key id. - A basic integration harness that runs preflight against a fixture bundle produced by `tools/make-test-bundle` (unsigned and signed variants). Notes / follow-ups: - Trust store + key rollover support: PR-24859. - Detached signature file layout: PR-24933. - Downgrade prevention using signed version metadata: PR-24902. - Improve error remediation messaging: PR-24873. Rollout consideration: This adds enforcement only when a bundle includes a `signing` block. For existing unsigned bundles used by customers, preflight will fail with a clear error; release engineering confirmed the next Private RC will ship signed bundles in parallel with an updated installer. Related: Linear ENG-4823 (installer preflight verification), ENG-4821 (manifest canonicalization), ENG-4822 (pipeline signing step).

review_conversation: Marcus Lin (Security): The verification must fail closed on any parsing ambiguity. Please confirm canonicalization is deterministic and signature never covers a partially parsed subset of the manifest.

Ethan Park (Author): Agree. Canonicalization re-encodes the full manifest struct (excluding the `signing.signature` field) with stable ordering; any JSON that fails strict decode errors out. Added a test for unknown fields under `signing` to ensure we fail.

Connor O'Brien (Release Eng): Key distribution: pinned key in binary is fine short-term, but we need a path to rotate without forcing an installer rebuild for air-gapped customers. Can you leave a seam for a trust store?
Ethan Park (Author): Added `TrustedKeyProvider` interface; default implementation returns the embedded key. Follow-up PR will add filesystem-backed trust store and support multiple keys (ENG-4825).
Sahana Iyer (Build/CI): Please avoid depending on non-standard JSON libs if possible. Also ensure any test fixtures are generated deterministically.

Ethan Park (Author): Using stdlib JSON + a small canonical encoder; fixtures generated via `tools/make-test-bundle` with fixed timestamps in tests. Removed an earlier dependency on a third-party canonical JSON package.
Sean Gallagher (SRE): Can we log a single-line summary for preflight results and include the manifest digest? This will help when customers paste logs into tickets.
Ethan Park (Author): Added a summary line: `preflight.verify_bundle_signature: PASS key_id=... manifest_sha256=...` and mirrored it on failure with an error code.
Marcus Lin (Security) - Requested changes: Ensure we reject signatures with unsupported alg, and do not accept missing key id (prevents confusing trust selection).
Ethan Park (Author): Implemented explicit allowlist (`ed25519` only for v0) and require `key_id` to be set; updated tests accordingly.
Connor O'Brien (Release Eng) - Approval: Looks good for phase 1. Please link this PR from the release gating checklist once merged.
Marcus Lin (Security) - Approval: Approved with follow-up required for trust store and key rotation.
Sean Gallagher (SRE) - Approval: Good to merge.

Preflight output includes manifest SHA-256 digest and structured error codes for Support triage.
